ENR 5.5 AERIAL SPORTING AND RECREATIONAL ACTIVITIES

1 GLIDER, HANG/PARAGLIDER, ULM, UAS

Note:
- Gliders and hang/paragliders may be launched up to the height in column 2 before releasing the winch cable. The winch cable forms an almost invisible obstacle APRX 1 NM around the geographical position.
- Glider pilots who are not familiar with the local soaring and/or landing procedures shall contact the residential gliding club.
- Model aircraft can be present up to 1000 FT AGL in class G airspace and military CTRs outside operating hours. Model flying sites in the vicinity of an airport can be published on the relevant visual approach chart.
- This list of activities may not be complete.

2 PARACHUTE JUMPING

Parachute jumping takes place in listed areas and aerodromes, which may be grouped together in clusters. Each area and cluster is situated in a climb-out area (see paragraph 2.3).

Note:
  • Listed aerodromes and sites are for regular parachute jumping (including free fall parachuting). Listing a site or aerodrome does not imply any right to use that site or aerodrome.

3 SIMULATED FORCED LANDING AREAS

The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has designated the areas listed below for the purpose of simulating forced landings. Additionally, simulated forced landings may only be conducted:
  • with a single engine aircraft;
  • subject to a minimum flight altitude of 100 FT above the ground or water, and at least 100 FT above the highest obstacle located within a distance of 600 M from the aircraft;
  • during the uniform daylight period;
  • in the presence and under supervision of an instructor.

Notwithstanding the above, it is not permitted to conduct a simulated forced landing:
  • over roads, canals, lakes, rivers, and areas designated for the presence of people; 
  • over people or livestock.

Note: areas are depicted on the LFR - LFA index chart in ENR 6.

4 MANNED FREE BALLOON FLIGHTS

For the following civil aerodromes balloon ascents are allowed under certain conditions (see ENR 1.2):
  • AMELAND/Ameland
  • BREDA/Seppe
  • DEVENTER/Teuge
  • HILVERSUM/Hilversum
  • HOOGEVEEN/Hoogeveen
  • MAASTRICHT/Maastricht Aachen
  • MIDDELBURG/Midden-Zeeland
  • OOSTWOLD/Oostwold
  • TEXEL/Texel
  • WEERT/Budel

Note:   balloon ascents can take place at areas other than aerodromes.
